# Question Opener

Component ID: question-opener

## Narrative intent

用一个可回答的问题和必要背景开场，让观众知道后续内容要解决什么。

Select this recipe only when the current story event needs that audience outcome; the animation alone is not evidence that the outcome was delivered.

## Purpose and selection

- Open with one answerable question and enough context to explain why it matters.

Do not use:

- Do not use multiple unrelated questions, misleading suspense or a conclusion disguised as a question.

## Reading order and motion

- Identify the topic
- Read one question
- Read its context
- Hold the question before the answer

Pattern: progressive-build. Native default duration: 8s. Minimum final readable hold: 0.7s.

### question

- Target: .question-title
- Visible action: Reveal one answerable question
- Authored start: 1.2s; action duration: 0.7s.
- Narration cue: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Reveal one answerable question. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.

### context

- Target: .question-context
- Visible action: Reveal why the question matters
- Authored start: 3.1s; action duration: 0.65s.
- Narration cue: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Reveal why the question matters. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.

### resolve

- Target: .question
- Visible action: Settle the question before answering
- Authored start: 6.6s; action duration: 0.55s.
- Narration cue: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

These are authored event defaults, not measured speech alignment. Rebind active events to actual narration at project FPS; omitted capacity items must not acquire phantom cues. ## Known failure modes and recovery

- overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or use a more suitable component; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
- missingInput: Resolve the actual required input or report the missing content; do not substitute demo defaults or custom graphics under recipes-only policy.
- timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
- inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.

Under recipes-only policy, missing capability means another validated recipe, a meaningful split or an explicit gap; not custom graphics disguised as reuse.
